DROP TABLE [BNKM].[IndividualCustomer]
GO

SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE TABLE [BNKM].[IndividualCustomer]
( 
	[CustomerId] [varchar](20)  NOT NULL,
	[IndividualCustomerName] [nvarchar](512)  NULL,
	[DateOfBirth] [date]  NULL,
	[DateOfDeath] [date]  NULL,
	[SexId] [char](1)  NULL,
	[GenderId] [varchar](10)  NULL,
	[EthnicCategoryId] [varchar](10)  NULL,
	[RacialCategoryId] [varchar](10)  NULL,
	[PreferredName] [varchar](60)  NULL,
	[ShortName] [varchar](10)  NULL,
	[NamePrefix] [varchar](60)  NULL,
	[FirstName] [nvarchar](512)  NULL,
	[MiddleName] [nvarchar](512)  NULL,
	[LastName] [nvarchar](512)  NULL,
	[NameSuffix] [nvarchar](512)  NULL,
	[BirthPlaceCountry] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[BirthPlaceCity] [varchar](60)  NULL,
	BirthPlace varchar(50),
	SpouseName varchar(100),
	[NonResidentIndicator] [char](1)  NULL,
	[MothersMaidenName] [nvarchar](512)  NULL,
	[EmployeeIndicator] [char](1)  NULL,
	[Dosri] [char](1)  NULL,
	[DosriTypeId] [varchar](30)  NULL,
	[MinorIndicator] [char](1)  NULL,
	[Segment] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[RelatedPartyIndicator] [char](1)  NULL,
	[RelatedPartyTypeId] [varchar](100)  NULL,
	[FATCAIndicator] [char](1)  NULL,
	[FATCATypeId] [varchar](50)  NULL,
	TaxIdentificationNumber varchar(50),
	[SourceCode] [varchar](20)  NULL,
	[FinancialInstitutionId] [varchar](20)  NOT NULL,
	[WorkFlowId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[TaskRunId] [bigint]  NULL,
	[InsertDttm] [datetime]  NULL
)
WITH
(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
GO
